units.english: How exactly Quarg thrusters work is unknown, but the mechanism that powers even this small set of engines consumes more energy than some human warships. Where all this energy goes is a complete mystery.
units.raw: description "How exactly Quarg thrusters work is unknown, but the mechanism that powers even this small set of engines consumes more energy than some human warships. Where all this energy goes is a complete mystery."

units.english: These engines also have strange capabilities which seem to violate the laws of physics as humanity understands them. Ships equipped with them accelerate faster under their own power than one would expect, while also taking less impact from external forces.
units.raw: description "	These engines also have strange capabilities which seem to violate the laws of physics as humanity understands them. Ships equipped with them accelerate faster under their own power than one would expect, while also taking less impact from external forces."

units.english: Despite their small size, these Quarg steering engines can turn their ships on a dime. It is rumored that, unlike human steering thrusters, the Quarg do not care where on the hull these are installed, producing the same rotational moment even if directly in line with the ship's center of mass.

units.english: Quarg thrusters are quite powerful for their size and produce very little heat, but at the cost of consuming immense amounts of energy. The mechanism by which they produce thrust is unknown, but it is rumored that the passing of a Quarg ship wreaks havoc on every gravitational wave antenna in the system.

units.english: According to rumor, some Quarg ships have their steering engines installed internally, with no need for external thrusters. Much like a gyroscope, they can seemingly orient a ship from anywhere, but unlike them they never seem to saturate or become locked.

units.english: This large set of Quarg thrusters is both powerful and subtle, leaving behind no bright exhaust trail nor emitting any detectable radiation aside from a faint violet glow. This is juxtaposed with the extreme amount of energy these engines consume, enough to power entire stations.

units.english: Quarg ships are famed for their ability to turn quickly and precisely, as though oriented by a divine hand rather than the flickering exhaust of human steering thrusters. According to some guesses on their mode of operation, this may be closer to the truth than not.
